plugins.name: dvera
plugins.description: Connect AI coding-agent context to CT (Controller Tester) C/C++ verification workflows: project preparation, analysis, test generation, execution, coverage, reporting, and regression follow-up.

skills.name: ct-analysis-loop
skills.description: Use this skill during the CT project analysis phase to classify errors, repeat conf or toolchain fixes, and continue until analysis succeeds.
headings: Output Schema (fields added or updated on Phase 4 success)
skills.description_zh: 在CT项目分析阶段分类错误，反复修复配置或工具链并继续至分析成功。

skills.name: ct-extract-macro
skills.description: Use this skill to extract the target compiler's compiler-default macros and build the shared environment analysis fields used during CT project preparation.
skills.description_zh: 提取目标编译器默认宏，建立CT项目准备所需共享环境分析字段。

skills.name: ct-init-project
skills.description: Use this skill to run the CT full pipeline from Phase 0 initial setup through macro extraction, conf and toolchain creation, analysis, testing, and observation-record collection, or to perform only the project-preparation stage.
headings: Initial Input Card for New Sessions
Step 1: Decide the state and entry mode
Step 4: Analysis stage in end-to-end entry mode
Step 5: Test stage in end-to-end entry mode
skills.description_zh: 运行CT从初始设置、宏提取、配置工具链、分析测试到观察记录的全流程，也可仅执行项目准备。

skills.name: ct-kb-update
skills.description: Use this skill to append single-change attempt results to `observations.jsonl`. It is called by `ct-init-project` or `ct-orchestrator` immediately after the CT-apply full pipeline completes.
skills.description_zh: 在CT完整应用流程结束后把单项变更尝试结果追加到observations.jsonl，供初始化或协调器调用。

skills.name: ct-make-conf
skills.description: Use this skill to generate the conversion analysis `.conf` and toolchain metadata (`.ini`, `.info`) from extracted target macros and `compiler_info`, and to record fingerprints.
headings: Output Schema (fields added or updated in Phase 2)
skills.description_zh: 根据目标宏与compiler_info生成CT转换分析配置和工具链元数据，并记录指纹。

skills.name: ct-open
skills.description: Launch CT with the current workspace. Use when you need to inspect the project visually in CT IDE during agent work.
headings: Step 2: Resolve the workspace to launch with
Step 3: Shut down the CT Bridge
skills.description_zh: 在当前工作区启动CT IDE，供智能体工作时可视化检查项目。

skills.name: ct-orchestrator
skills.description: Use this skill to continue an existing `state.json` session and decide whether to resume `ct-init-project`, `ct-analysis-loop`, or `ct-test-loop` from the current status.
headings: Step 2: Load state.json and Decide the Current Phase Range
skills.description_zh: 依据已有state.json继续CT会话，判断恢复项目初始化、分析循环或测试循环。

skills.name: ct-regression
skills.description: Use after a code change to rerun existing tests and report regression status (new failures and coverage deltas).
skills.description_zh: 代码修改后重新运行CT既有测试，报告新失败与覆盖变化。

skills.name: ct-report
skills.description: Use this skill to export the test results and coverage of a CT project that has already been executed into a PDF/HTML/XLSX report.
skills.description_zh: 将已执行CT项目的测试与覆盖结果导出PDF、HTML或Excel报告。

skills.name: ct-req-to-test
skills.description: Generate and execute a CT AI test for one analyzed C/C++ function from user-approved requirements, then review the resulting evidence.
skills.description_zh: 根据用户批准需求为一个已分析C或C++函数生成并执行CT AI测试，审阅证据。

skills.name: ct-run-gtest
skills.description: Re-run GoogleTest assets already registered in a CT project, then review their execution results and structural coverage.
headings: Verify the project and test scope
Execute the registered tests in CT
skills.description_zh: 重新运行CT项目已注册GoogleTest，检查执行结果和结构覆盖率。

skills.name: ct-self-healing
skills.description: Run CT regression evidence collection after a C/C++ change and identify when the deployed CT Self-Healing workflow should review affected tests.
headings: Run CT regression and collect evidence
skills.description_zh: C或C++变更后收集CT回归证据，识别已部署自愈工作流应审查的受影响测试。

skills.name: ct-setup-project
skills.description: Use this skill to create the CT toolchain and project for the host or conversion path, and to apply user include paths and defines as compile flags.
headings: Confirmation 2: Host Toolchain Selection (host mode only)
Output Schema (fields added or updated in Phase 3)
skills.description_zh: 创建CT主机或转换路径的工具链和项目，将用户头文件路径与宏定义作为编译参数。

skills.name: ct-test-loop
skills.description: Use this skill to generate and run tests on an analyzed CT project and correct build failures through a feedback loop. In standalone runs, you must first ask the user whether to use requirements-based or AI-code-analysis generation mode.
headings: Entry Mode Determination (Mandatory, Takes Precedence Over Other Procedures)
Standalone Execution Procedure (AI Code Analysis-Based Test Generation)
skills.description_zh: 对已分析CT项目生成运行测试并循环修复构建失败；单独运行时原说明要求先确认基于需求或AI代码分析的生成模式。
